result.nl_contract: 1. Harvest cap: Each fisher shall catch no more than 5 tons in any month. 2. Minimum cooperation target: Each fisher should aim to catch 5 tons when the lake has at least 25 tons at the start of the month; if the lake starts below 25 tons, each fisher should reduce harvest proportionally so the total group catch does not push the lake below 5 tons. 3. Sustainability rule: No fisher may knowingly take an amount that would cause the lake to fall below 5 tons after all harvests are applied. 4. Fairness rule: If the lake is abundant enough for all five fishers to take 5 tons, everyone takes 5 tons; no one may claim extra because others held back. 5. Mutual obligation: If any fisher violates the cap or sustainability rule, the others are released from the 5-ton target for the next month and may harvest conservatively to protect the lake. 6. Review: At the end of each month, we will compare actual catches and reaffirm the 5-ton norm if everyone complied.
